This page contains basic visa information for foreign citizens traveling to Bosnia and Herzegovina and for BiH citizens.
In addition to a biometric passport, BiH citizens travelling to EU member states and Schengen countries must have 35-70 euros in cash for each day of stay in the EU. Border services may require proof of funds for the stay in a particular country or information about the address where you will be staying.
When travelling to EU member states and Schengen countries, BiH citizens must have a travel document valid for at least 3 months from the date of their intended stay in the EU member states or Schengen countries.
Nationals of the following states may enter into Bosnia and Herzegovina with a passport or a valid identity card proving identity and citizenship of:
Member State of the European Union
Member State of the European Union
State signatory to the Schengen Agreement
State signatory to the Schengen Agreement
Andorra, Montenegro, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Serbia, the Holy See, Swiss Confederation, North Macedonia and Albania.
Andorra, Montenegro, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Serbia, the Holy See, Swiss Confederation, North Macedonia and Albania.
The minimum amount of financial resources required for the stay of foreigners on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina is KM 150.00 (or equivalent in freely convertible foreign currency) - for each day of the intended stay.
